 3h ago 18.18 EDT Time to sign off – I’ll leave you with Sid Lowe’s report. Thanks for joining me; until next time, it’s adios .
 Mbappé double secures Real Madrid late victory at Barcelona after Raphinha leveller Read more Share 3h ago 18.16 EDT Tomorrow night, the Ballon d’Or will be handed out in London . It’s long been framed as a race between Harry Kane and Lamine Yamal, but Kylian Mbappé’s odds have shortened today. He’s not going to win it this year, but if I could choose one player on earth to join my club, then on balance it would have to be Mbappé.
 Share 3h ago 18.09 EDT Here’s how the La Liga table stands – and it would be remiss of me not to mention Atlético, firmly in this title race after 10 games.

 Share 3h ago 18.02 EDT Full time: Barcelona 1-2 Real Madrid
 Barcelona’s perfect start ran for nine games, but it’s been shattered by – yes – a José Mourinho masterclass. Kylian Mbappé struck on the break in both halves to earn a statement victory for Real Madrid , who are now just three points behind the league leaders.
 Share 3h ago 18.00 EDT 95 mins: We play on, and Lamine Yamal almost picks out Gabriel Jesus with a cross … but Real Madrid break away again and Balde is booked for a reckless foul on Mbappe.
 Share 3h ago 17.59 EDT 94 mins: Cucurella and Mbappe are booked in quick succession, presumably for dissent. Juan Martinez is dishing out a few yellow cards after a relatively quiet game.
 Share Updated at  18.00 EDT 3h ago 17.58 EDT 93 mins: Two time-sapping substitutions from Mourinho, with Carlos Espi and Trent Alexander-Arnold replacing Diomande and Arda Guler.
 Share 3h ago 17.57 EDT 92 mins: Lamine Yamal goes over under pressure from Cucurella on the edge of the area, but the referee waves him up. Adeyemi then powers in a cross which Lunin punches away from danger.
 Share 3h ago 17.56 EDT “I’m kicking myself for not putting ‘Performs knee slide’ on the Mou bingo card,” sighs Peter Oh.
 Share Updated at  17.56 EDT 3h ago 17.55 EDT 90 mins: The stadium PA announces five extra minutes as a shell-shocked Barcelona search for a second equaliser.
 Share 3h ago 17.54 EDT It’s a second goal for Kylian Mbappé, created by a superb piece of skill from Bellingham to set Camavinga away. He gets beyond the weary Cubarsi and cuts back beyond Garcia, allowing Mbappé to roll the ball into an empty net. Mourinho knee-slides down the touchline in jubilation. He’s back!
 Share Updated at  17.55 EDT 3h ago 17.52 EDT GOAL! Barcelona 1-2 Real Madrid (Mbappé 87')
 With time running out, Real Madrid unleash a lethal counter attack – and they may have just snatched all three points here!
 View image in fullscreen Kylian Mbappe has won it for Real! Photograph: Albert Gea/Reuters Share Updated at  17.57 EDT 3h ago 17.50 EDT 85 mins: Karim Adeyemi and Gabriel Jesus are on, replacing Gordon and goalscorer Raphinha.
 Share 3h ago 17.49 EDT 84 mins: Gordon tackles Guler to stop a potential Real Madrid break, and isn’t best pleased when he’s booked. A rare bad call from tonight’s referee.
 Share 3h ago 17.48 EDT 83 mins: To return to my earlier, slightly tenuous boxing comparison, Real Madrid are on the ropes – but they could still find a knockout blow with Mbappe and Bellingham waiting to pounce on the break.
 Share 3h ago 17.47 EDT 82 mins: Gordon plays a cute pass in to Lamine’s path, but his shot is blocked by Cucurella, who followed him for a good 20 yards there.
 Share 3h ago 17.45 EDT 81 mins: Lamine Yamal, now suddenly everywhere, whips a shot across goal but it is blocked, inadvertently, by Dean Huijsen’s bonce.
 Share 3h ago 17.44 EDT 80 mins: De Jong’s snap-shot is closed down, and Real Madrid deal with the subsequent corner. Bernardo Silva’s race is run; he’s replaced by Eduardo Camavinga.
 Share 3h ago 17.43 EDT 78 mins: At the other end, Lamine Yamal goes close again, dancing beyond his marker and pounding an effort wide with the outside of his boot.
 Share 4h ago 17.42 EDT 76 mins: Another Real break, although the first for a while, is led by Mbappe and ends with Gerard Martin expertly tackling Bellingham. He and Cubarsi have been left to fend for themselves in the heart of Barça’s defence.
 Share 4h ago 17.40 EDT An email from Colin Fordham, on this intriguing clash of styles. “After Mbappé’s rather lucky goal and the impressive Mourinho-inspired defensive effort of Real Madrid with everyone, Bellingham included, pressing Barca’s players to the nth degree, it was refreshing to see pure football. Pedri’s feint and pass for Rafinha, and the Brazilian’s finish, were sublime.”
 Share 4h ago 17.39 EDT 75 mins: Dumfries looks for Mbappe over the top, but Garcia is off his line to deal with the through ball.
 Share 4h ago 17.38 EDT 73 mins: Almost a moment of Lamine Yamal magic as he plays a cross-shot with the outside of his boot that just evades Raphinha at the far post. Barcelona make another change, with Frenkie De Jong replacing Fermin Lopez.
 Share 4h ago 17.37 EDT 72 mins: Bernardo Silva is penalised for a foul in midfield. Barça looked the more leggy team for the first hour, but Real Madrid are beginning to tire.
 Share 4h ago 17.36 EDT 71 mins: Arda Guler has another go from the edge of the area, a low fizzer that Garcia gets behind. I’m not sure if Guler is exciting, frustrating or a mixture of the two.
 Share 4h ago 17.35 EDT 70 mins: Still, I reckon José might see it differently.
 Share 4h ago 17.35 EDT 69 mins: Balde scrambles the corner away, but Mbappe appeals for handball. The ball definitely hit Balde’s arm, before passing under it, but it would be very harsh to give that with both players jostling each other.
 Share 4h ago 17.32 EDT 68 mins: Dumfries steams down the right and his underhit cross towards Mbappe is cleared behind by Balde. Real Madrid get a corner …
 Share 4h ago 17.32 EDT 66 mins: The xG for this game is currently at 0.96-0.86 in Barcelona’s favour. So, 1-1 seems a fair scoreline.
 Share 4h ago 17.30 EDT 65 mins: Big save! Barça win another corner, met by Gerard Martin with a header six yards out – but Lunin claws it off the line to keep the scores level!
 Share 4h ago 17.28 EDT 63 mins: A first change for the visitors, with Denzel Dumfries replacing Fede Valverde at right-back. Arda Guler takes aim from a distance, forcing Garcia into an awkward save-clearance combo.
 Share Updated at  17.31 EDT 4h ago 17.27 EDT GOAL! Barcelona 1-1 Real Madrid (Raphinha 61')
 It’s played short, and Pedri plays a lovely reverse pass inside for Raphinha, who fires an effort through Bellingham’s legs. Lunin gets a hand to his effort, but it has too much power. After a torrid first hour, Barcelona are level!
 View image in fullscreen Raphinha scores for Barca! Photograph: Lluís Gené/AFP/Getty Images Share Updated at  17.49 EDT 4h ago 17.25 EDT 60 mins: Gordon pings a low ball across the area, which Cucurella clears behind with undue haste. And from the corner …
 Share 4h ago 17.24 EDT 59 mins: It looks like Diomande’s calf problem may have been caused by Joao Cancelo’s challenge, which is better news than a muscle injury.
